_readme: Read-only access to Strata's model folder, for the model chat's 'models' tool.
This file exists so that the tool that reads the model library is READ-ONLY in
code, not by the model's good behaviour. Every change is prohibited outright:
the model files are tens of gigabytes of downloadable material, and nothing in
a chat has any business rewriting, moving or deleting them. Reading is never
gated by serve/../tools/filesystem_mcp.py, which is the whole point of a
`**` names everything under the root the server was started with, at any
depth, so this list does not have to change when the model folder moves to
another drive or another name: tools/sync_model_tools.py starts the server on
whatever folder Strata's data_dir setting names at the time.
enforce must be true. If this file cannot be read, the server refuses every
change anyway (it fails closed), and says so.

prohibited.note: The model library is read-only to the chat. Downloading, packing and moving it is setup's work, not a tool call.
